title: Iowa woman wins foreclosure appeal after lender failed to notify co-owner

title: Renaissance painting unseen for 70 years identified as rare £5m Altdorfer

With ten children to support, Ramos depended on the life insurance policy that the jury ruled Farmers Insurance improperly refused, illustrating their bad faith.
